title: SIDESTORY: BREAK THE ICE OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: BREAK THE ICE OPEN
DETAILS: Break the Ice event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Kjerag Guidebook] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Kjera, Kjerag-Style Inn Furniture (Pieces), Stone of Kjeragandr.
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Stone of Kjeragandr by clearing event stages. Stone of Kjeragandr can be used to redeem items from [Turicum Trade Zone].
MAIN REWARDS: Kjera’s Token, Kjerag-Style Inn Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, LMD, Furniture Parts, Elite Materials, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Edelweiss' Vow", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.
Operator Kjera is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Break the Ice. Operator Kjera is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Operator Gnosis and Aurora will be permanently added to other Headhuntings in future update.
Operator Gnosis, Aurora, and Kjera will gain more trust in the event stages.
04 ICEFIELD MESSENGER COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Icefield Messenger Collection - Hohenlohe Chillysand for Carnelian
Icefield Messenger Collection - Hope Cruise for Leonhardt
Icefield Messenger Collection - Cardboard Fairy for Kafka
05 CAMBRIAN SERIES RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Cambrian Series - Soft Wool for Bibeak
Cambrian Series - Modeling Night for Gravel
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Kjerag-Style Inn, will be available during the event.
- Break the Ice event rewards and redeem in Turicum Trade Zone (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from June 30, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – July 14, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7).
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Kuro's Festive New Home * 1, Supporter Chip Pack * 3
Day 2: Icefield Messenger Collection - Gift Uncompleted for Beanstalk * 1, LMD * 30000
Day 4: Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 15
Day 8: Strategic Battle Record * 15, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1
Day 9: Yan-Style Dressing Table * 1, Skill Summary - 3 * 10
The Top Emergency Sanity Potion from this event will be expired on July 18, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
